description: We are a travel-inspired group of women who believe that quality girl time, escape from routine and a little indulgence is good for the soul.
body:
THE GG TEAM

We are a travel-inspired group of women who believe that quality girl time, escape from routine and a little indulgence is good for the soul.

OUR STORY

Meet Jen - our Girl Boss

Born with a desire to nurture women’s friendships and provide ladies with quality time away from life’s demands, Girls Getaways was started by our Girl Boss, Jen, in 2014.

Always the organiser in her friend group, Jen long had a love for travel, as well as professional experience in tourism and event management, yet it wasn’t until she was asked to help organise a friend’s hens that she decided to turn this passion into a business.

From that moment, Girls Getaways has developed into a close-knit interstate team, expanded into over 25 domestic and international destinations and established a Hope in the Hunter event series that has donated over $40,000 to Pink Hope. Now set on growing across Australia, Jen can’t wait to provide more women with the chance to Escape, Indulge & Relax.

OUR TEAM

  • KATHRYN - GLOBAL GAL

    Kathryn has been travelling the globe since her early twenties and has resided in six countries, collecting girlfriends along the way. She locks all girls into their weekends and makes escaping as smooth as possible.

  • PRUE - HEART OF OPS

    Prue brings a wealth of expertise & a touch of sparkle to every occasion. Her passion for creating unforgettable experiences shines through in everything she does, whether she's orchestrating a grand event or planning a chic getaway - events are her passion and operations has her heart.

  • DIANA - ALL STAR ACCOUNTANT

    Diana is our queen of accounts! With years of experience in the field, Diana is all over it when it comes to numbers and will be overseeing all things accounting and bookkeeping, making sure that everything is kept in check, and that your getaway runs smoothly within our operations team!

The GG Sisterhood

JOIN NOW

OUR PINK HOPE PARTNERSHIP

How do we support Pink Hope?

Deeply empathising with Pink Hope’s mission of empowering women to take action against their risk of breast and ovarian cancer, Girls Getaways has developed an ongoing event series, Holidays for Hope. These events are based in our most popular regional destinations and involve groups of 100-150 women coming together to show their support.

On our Holidays for Hope weekends, we invite women of all ages to join us for canape nights, wine tours, and long lunches, with 50% of all package profits supporting Pink Hope. With these funds, our team organises retreats for women affected by breast and ovarian cancer, offering them much-needed time to relax, unwind and recover.

SEE UPCOMING EVENTS

GG GIFT CARDS

We may be a little biased but we truly believe there’s no better gal-to-gal present than the promise of a future getaway!

Why give a GG Gift Card?

How are they delivered?

What is the minimum value for a gift card?

What is the minimum value for a gift card?

THE DETAILS

With a GG Gift Card, you can gift a girlfriend a contribution toward her next weekend away! Depending on the amount you choose and the package in mind, you may opt to cover a percentage or the full cost of her next trip – perfect for anyone that is overdue for a little indulgence.

Our gift cards are delivered electronically via email to your lucky lady. They will feature our classic GG branding and the details of the amount she’s received along with steps on how to redeem the voucher.

Our gift cards have a minimum value of $99 and can be used towards any of our Girls Getaway packages. We recommend taking a look at our getaways and keeping an eye out for a package that your gal might like so you roughly know your contribution.

Our gift cards are valid for three years and can be redeemed via email. By following our simple steps, your lucky lady can contact our passionate booking team who will help to credit value towards a day trip or weekend stay.

$100

Covers a portion of the cost on any of our Girls Day Out packages or overnight stays.

HOW IT WORKS

$200

Covers a number of our girl’s day out packages including Style Queens & High Teas, Soothe, Sip & Savour and Bellinis & Blowouts.

$350

Covers a number of our girl’s weekends including By the Bay in Port Stephens, Breakfree in the Hunter Valley and Nibble & Nourish in Brisbane.

$500

Covers our more indulgent girls getaways including Coastal Escape in Newcastle and Penthouses, Pools & Pina Coladas in Byron Bay.

Note that any booking will attract cancellation fees and travel amendment rules will apply. Once the deposit is paid, we will confirm your booking with the relevant third party suppliers.

You and your co-travellers may pay us directly by credit card (Mastercard and Visa) or by Direct Debit or by internet bank transfer.

You indemnify us against any liability that we may have to third party suppliers as a result of any failure on your part to make a payment or for any damage or injury that you may cause during the course of your attendance at the premises or venue of the third party supplier.


MEDICAL ISSUES

TRAVEL INSURANCE

HOW IT WORKS

From researching where to go, to booking activities and gathering payments, we’re set on taking the stress out of planning girls weekends.

OUR BOOKING PROCESS

  • Choose your dream girls getaway

    Select one (or more) of our packages that you’d love to escape on and fill out the Booking Request form.

  • We'll confirm package availability

    After receiving your enquiry, we’ll check your dates and send through an info sheet with the price and a link to book.

  • You lock in your getaway

    When you click the link to book, we’ll reserve your package and send through a Booking Confirmation with payment instructions.

  • Take off on your hassle-free escape

    Enjoy the bliss of having all of the finer details taken care of and relax with your girl group from the moment you arrive.

  • Pay final balances prior to arrival

    The girls can then choose to pay the remaining amount in full or in installments up until 4-6 weeks prior (due date is dependant on the package).

  • All the girls can pay individually to us

    Through a link on the Booking Confirmation, we ask each of the girls to pay a percentage deposit within 7 days.

OUR BOOKING PROCESS

  • Choose your dream girl's getaway.

  • We confirm package availability.

    After receiving your enquiry, we’ll check your dates and send through an Info Sheet with a link to book.

  • You lock in your getaway.

    By selecting the link to book, we reserve your package and send through a Booking Confirmation.

  • All the girls pay directly to us.

  • All the girls pay final balances to us.

    The girls can then choose to pay the remaining amount in full or in installments up until two weeks prior.

  • Take off on your hassle-free escape.

    Enjoy the bliss of having all of the smaller details taken care of and getaway with your girl group carefree!

FAQS

How far out should I book a Girls Getaway?

As soon as possible! Once you’ve agreed upon a date it’s best to book straight away to avoid disappointment. A general rule of thumb is 4-5 months in advance, however, if you and your girlfriends are the spontaneous types, we may be able to accommodate you, depending on availability.

How can I find out the price and availability for one of your packages?

We are a web-based business that works with multiple properties and varying prices. Once you have found your desired package on our website, please click the ‘booking request’ button and fill in the form with as many details as you can. Our Reservations Team will be in touch as soon as they can.

Can I change the package inclusions?

While we may not be able to change the Inclusions completely, we can certainly alter some according to different preferences. For example, if you would like to prolong your pamper, add on a meal or include an extra activity, we are happy to oblige. Please specify this in the ‘special notes’ section of the booking request form.

Are numbers flexible?

Numbers are somewhat flexible depending on the package. Please consider the group numbers on each package page as a guide to what each property can accommodate. If you would like a package for just two people or a large group, let us know and we will do our best to find a package that is suitable.

Do we offer flexible sleeping options?

We understand that every girl group has different requirements and preferences so we try to offer various accommodation types that offer shared and private rooms to cater to everyone’s needs. Please specify any bedding configuration requests in the ‘special notes’ section of the booking request form.

Can guys come on the getaway?

Our packages are designed with women in mind however if a male would like to join and they are happy to have all the inclusions then sure thing!

What is the minimum age allowed?

This depends on the package. Some properties do require guests to be over 25 years, while others which include wine tours and cocktail classes require all guests to be over 18 years. If you are unsure, please check with us.

How do I pay?

To reduce the hassle for the leading lady (organiser), our payment structure allows each girl in your group to pay direct using a safe online checkout link found on their booking confirmation or by direct deposit. You can either pay in instalments or upfront. Either way, we require a minimum deposit of $200 per person due within 7 days of booking and the remaining balance 4-6 weeks prior to your travel date (unless specified otherwise).

What is our standard cancellation policy?

Our standard cancellation policy is as follows:

  • A booking cancelled more than 6 weeks prior to departure - your non-refundable deposit is payable on cancellation;

  • A booking cancelled less than 6 weeks but more than 4 weeks prior to departure – 50% of the total cost of the travel products or package is payable on cancellation; and

  • A booking cancelled less than 4 weeks before departure – 100% of the total cost of the travel products or package is payable on cancellation.

Special cancellation conditions may also apply to particular tours and packages if stipulated by third-party suppliers and may override the above conditions. Read our full terms and conditions, including our COVID-19 policy here.

While we strive to respond within 48 hours, we are a small team and in busier periods it may take a little longer to get back to everyone. Occasionally, our emails can end up in your spam so please also check there.

title: BEFORE YOU BOOK
body:
How far out should I book a Girls Getaway?

As soon as possible! Once you’ve agreed upon a date it’s best to book straight away to avoid disappointment. A general rule of thumb is 4-5 months in advance, however, if you and your girlfriends are the spontaneous types, we may be able to accommodate you, depending on availability. As you can imagine, all our popular getaways are in high demand and sell out quickly.

How can I find out the price and availability for one of your packages?

We are a web-based business that works with multiple properties and varying prices. Once you have found your desired package on our website, please click the ‘booking request’ button and fill in the form with as many details as you can. Our Reservations Team will be in touch as soon as they can.

Can I change the package inclusions?

While we may not be able to change the Inclusions completely, we can certainly alter some according to different preferences. For example, if you would like to prolong your pamper, add on a meal or include an extra activity, we are happy to oblige. Please specify this in the ‘special notes’ section of the booking request form

Are numbers flexible?

Numbers are somewhat flexible depending on the package. Please consider the group numbers on each package page on our website as a guide to what each property can accommodate. If you would like a package for just two people or a large group, we will do our best to find a package that is suitable.

Do we offer flexible sleeping options?

We understand that every girl group has different requirements and preferences so we try to offer various accommodation types that offer shared and private rooms to cater to everyone’s needs. Please specify any bedding configuration requests in the ‘special notes’ section of the booking request form.

Can males come on the getaway?

Our packages are designed with women in mind however if a male would like to join and they are happy to have all the inclusions then sure thing!

What is the minimum age you can book a package?

This depends on the package. Some properties do require guests to be over 25 years, while others which include wine tours and cocktail classes require all guests to be over 18 years. If you are unsure, please check with us.

How do I pay?

To reduce the hassle for the leading lady (organiser), our payment structure allows each girl in your group to pay direct using a safe online checkout link found on their booking confirmation or by direct deposit. You can either pay in instalments or upfront. Either way, we require a minimum deposit per person due within 7 days of booking and the remaining balance due 4-6 weeks prior to your travel date (unless specified otherwise).

What is our standard cancellation policy?

Our standard cancellation policy is as follows:

  • A booking cancelled more than 6 weeks prior to departure - Your non-refundable deposit is payable on cancellation;

  • A booking cancelled less than 6 weeks but more than 4 weeks prior to departure – 50% of the total cost of the travel products or package is payable on cancellation; and

  • A booking cancelled less than 4 weeks before departure – 100% of the total cost of the travel products or package is payable on cancellation.

Special cancellation conditions may also apply to particular tours and packages if stipulated by third party suppliers and may override the above conditions.

Read our full terms and conditions, including our COVID-19 policy here.

I submitted a booking request, but I haven't heard anything?

While we strive to respond within 48 hours, we are a small team and in busier periods it may take a little longer to get back to everyone. Occasionally, our emails can end up in your spam so please also check there.

LEADING UP TO YOUR GETAWAY

What happens after I have booked?

Once you've made a booking, paid your deposit and submitted your group details and preferences all you need to do is relax and let us organise everything. Once we have received full payment from all the girls we will send you all the necessary vouchers a week prior to your getaway. For example, you will receive your accommodation voucher that must be presented upon check-in.

We have a package booked, are all the package inclusions booked before the weekend or do we just do it when we get there?

All your inclusions are booked by the Girls Getaways team prior to your weekend away. When booking these in we take into consideration your preferred times (submitted via the ‘What’s Next’ form included in your booking confirmation) and will do our best to accommodate these with our suppliers' availability. During this process, our team may be in contact with you to double-check preferences so please continue to check your emails.

Do we pay our balances when we arrive at the accommodation?

Your balances are typically due 4-6 weeks prior to your travel date, unless we have specified otherwise. Your due dates and payment options are on your booking confirmation. Once we receive full payment from each girl travelling we will issue your travel vouchers with all the details you need to check in to your accommodation and enjoy your inclusions.

Someone has pulled out of our getaway, what can I do?

If someone drops out of your getaway, this will alter the price for everyone as there are now fewer people to share the costs of your accommodation and/or inclusions. In this case, we recommend trying to find someone else to take their place, so that the price and package can stay the same. Please notify us of any changes, including the name of the guest not attending and the new guest's name if you have one so that we can make the necessary package alterations. Please note, the minimum deposit is non-refundable however this can either be transferred to the new guest or help cover the cost of accommodation.

I’ve paid money but you have said you haven't received it?

Occasionally we receive money without a reference so we may ask you to please send a screenshot of the payment and email this to us so that our accounts can trace the payment and link it with the correct group.

Can I get an early or late check-out?

If you are staying in a hotel, we recommend calling reception to ask on the day of check-in. If you are staying in a property we will need to ask the property manager and it often depends on whether any groups are checking out the morning before your arrival as cleaning needs to be done. Please don’t plan on an early check-in being guaranteed.

What happens to our deposit if we cancel?

If you cancel you will forfeit your non-refundable deposits. However, if you choose to postpone your getaway instead (and if this is possible with our suppliers) then we are willing to hold these deposits in credit for you and put them towards a getaway on a new date. Please email us so we can look at your options.

Can I add a girl to our booking?

If your accommodation and inclusions have space for an extra person then this shouldn’t be a problem. Please email us the details for the new guest so that we can re-quote your package and advise the new per-person cost.

THE DAY OF YOUR GETAWAY

I have a booking today and I don't know the address of the house?

Please check the documents that were sent to the leading lady (organiser), the address and check-in details will be on your accommodation voucher.

I am at the property that I have booked and I don't have the code for the lockbox or the code didn’t work / can’t find the lockbox?

Please double-check the lockbox details on the accommodation voucher emailed to the leading lady (organiser). If you are still having trouble either locating the lockbox or accessing the property, please contact the property manager as they will be the best person to help. Their details should be on your accommodation voucher.

I have just got into our accommodation and I can't find towels or tv controls or there's no toilet paper etc.?

For any questions related to your accommodation, please contact either the property manager (their contact details will be on your accommodation voucher) or reception if there is one, they will be the best people to help.

I was meant to get a grazing platter delivered and it's not here?

Our suppliers do have other deliveries so times may vary slightly. If you are concerned, please call the supplier directly – their contact details will be on the documents emailed to the leading lady. Just remember, they may not answer if they are driving so leave a message and they will come back to you. They have your contact number so if they can't find you they will call you.

We are stuck in traffic and are running late and not sure if we can make it in time?

Please contact the pamper therapist and let them know. Their number will be provided on travel vouchers that were emailed to the leading lady.

WINE TOUR RELATED QUESTIONS

Is my wine tour private?

We cannot always guarantee that your wine tour will be private as it depends on the destination, group size and available suppliers. If you are a small group, it is likely that you will share a bus with other groups.

Can I select the pickup time or cellar doors?

The wine tour companies we work with handle all the cellar door bookings and will determine the appropriate pick-up time which will be given to your or confirmed via text by the driver the day before. They select the best ones based on availability and groups size and everything is pre-booked so that things run on schedule. They will try their best to accommodate requests on the day but these can not always be guaranteed.

Do the wine tours pick us up and drop us back at the end of the day?

Yes, the wine tours will pick you up from your accommodation and drop you back at the end of the tour.

I have someone in the group that doesn't like wine, do they still have to pay the same money?

Yes, our wine tours are all the same price, whether you are tasting or not.

Have a question we haven’t answered in our FAQs? Please don’t hesitate to reach out to our team.
